description: This file is a shell script (install.sh) intended for installing and configuring the OpenClaw software project on macOS and Linux systems. It contains functions and logic for detecting environment, installing dependencies, setting up tools like Node.js, npm, pnpm, git, and configuring the user's system for OpenClaw. It also manages version resolution, install methods (npm or git), and provides user prompts and output formatting. The script supports various holiday and custom taglines and has comprehensive handling for different package managers and system configurations.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to set configuration flags for the installer.

methods.name: configure_verbose
methods.description: Configures verbosity level, setting npm log level and shell options.

methods.name: is_promptable
methods.description: Determines whether the script can prompt the user interactively.

methods.name: prompt_choice
methods.description: Prompts the user for input with a custom message.

methods.name: detect_openclaw_checkout
methods.description: Detects if the provided directory is an OpenClaw checkout with package.json and pnpm-workspace.yaml, and correct name.

methods.name: install_homebrew
methods.description: Automatically installs Homebrew on macOS if not present.

methods.name: install_git
methods.description: Installs git using the system package manager or Homebrew.

methods.name: install_node
methods.description: Installs Node.js via Homebrew on macOS or package managers on Linux, including setup for Arch-based distros.

methods.name: check_node
methods.description: Checks if a suitable version of Node.js is installed.

methods.name: install_openclaw_from_git
methods.description: Clones the OpenClaw repository from GitHub, installs dependencies using pnpm, builds, and sets up symlinks and wrappers.

methods.name: install_openclaw_npm
methods.description: Installs the OpenClaw package globally via npm, with error handling and diagnostics.

methods.name: resolve_openclaw_bin
methods.description: Resolves the executable path for openclaw, checking various installation locations and environment configurations.

methods.name: run_doctor
methods.description: Runs the openclaw doctor command for migration and checks.

methods.name: maybe_open_dashboard
methods.description: Opens the openclaw dashboard if available.

methods.name: resolve_workspace_dir
methods.description: Determines the workspace directory based on profile.
